Honestly, avoid this game until Activision is transparent on how the multiplayer SBMM system works. As a player who started on COD4, there is no such thing as a casual game anymore. You are SWEATING to just try and have a 1.0KD game. I genuinely don't think the devs understand what made Call of Duty special. There are no highs and lows that made the gameplay loop so addicting. Every game feels like a ranked match that has a prize on the line. Whether they're using their Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment system or just straight SBMM for retention and to push MTX, which are both patented by Activision btw, it's ruining the game. I tried to give this game a fair shot but it is honestly not good for your mental health and isn't an enjoyable experience. If you're looking to play the campaign or DMZ go ahead, but do not buy this to have fun on the multiplayer.

I'd rather have thousand bulls step on my balls for a week straight, than play this piece of shit.
DMZ is beyond repetitive, only good for grinding camos. That is until you get killed by a guy camping at exfill or in a story mission.
When it comes to multiplayer, there are at most 3 maps I don't sigh at, whenever they're picked. You know it's bad, when the community misses Shipment 24/7. The whole game is a campfest, with people hiding behind corners with Ghost. Devs enable this kind of play, since tens of weapons require you to get kills while proning, shots from afar and such.
Aim Assist is cranked up to the max on consoles, with it working through smokes, completely defeating their purpose. Can't turn off crossplay on PC too, so you're stuck. Movement feels terrible as well, adding to the "campyness" of the game. Basic QoL stuff from earlier games is gone too, such as an overlay which shows individual weapons stats during a match (Headshots etc.).
Kill streaks are beyond laughable, with most people running the core three (UAV, Crossfire and Wheelson), since all the other ones suck.
Campaign was good, but that's only for 1-2 playthroughs.
In all honesty, if you want a good modern CoD game, just play BO7. Otherwise, stick to the originals.
Finally, a good campaign. Just don’t add any Fortnite skins and it’ll be a great game

I'm making another review because this needs to be known. I have very fast internet. This crap game quote on quote has an aggressive lag compensation. Meaning that players with higher ping are getting an advantage as the games engine is trying to predict and average out player movements. So when I am running around a corner and insta die before even seeing a player, I watch the kill cam and see my full body in frame. That is total BS. Why on earth would you penalize people with high internet. Refund me and I'm uninstalling. POS game.

The DMZ has great gunplay and an amazing map, however, completely ruined by forced PvP. I enabled squad fill for a Nuclear Power Plant mission but got deployed alone, managed to complete the mission solo, and then got hunted down by a three-man squad. Another time, I was sniped by a player from a nearby spawn right after clearing a stronghold. Extraction campers are everywhere, and even Story Mode is full of squads hunting players who are just trying to complete missions. I'm here to explore, fight AI, loot, and extract, not to be someone else's target practice. I don't understand why the developers refuse to offer a separate PvE-only mode. I'm not asking to remove PvP, just give PvE players a choice. This game has so much potential, but I'm done until a proper PvE-only mode is added.

Same shit, different toilet.. Activision literally announced back in 2022 that all COD studios are forced onto one single 'Unified Engine' (IW9) starting with MWII. The movement tech, tactical sprint, camera animations, and physics pipeline in Multiplayer have been recycled on the exact same codebase since MW19/MW22. Changing slide cancellation speeds or weapon tuning every November isn't a new engine—it's literally just a balance patch on 6-year-old underlying tech.

Absolute dogsh*t. Fell for it again award. Despite years of outcry from the people who put ill-deserved revenue in the pocket of the inept exec/shareholder-fiends pulling the strings on this franchise, the thirst for MTX-led KPIs has won out again, as player retention manipulation is dialed up in this game higher than ever. Feels horrible to play, completely inorganic matchmaking designed to exploit and fry the reward systems in your brain. The only way you will enjoy this is if you are in the 20% demographic of absolutely awful players who end up carried and coddled against the other terrible players, or the 10% demographic of absolutely cracked players who don't mind sweating like a coke fiend for no reason in public matches. For anyone with normal brain chemistry, the entire multiplayer experience feels like an exercise in patience to test your tolerance for being abused by an algorithm that so blatantly disrespects your time and energy. Inevitably, your play session will end with you deciding to turn it off because it feels bad, you're exhausted, and left questioning why you booted up the game to begin with. This is junk food. A fluorescent light only to be enjoyed by moths. Don't waste your time with this hollow representation of the childhood fun that got everyone started with the Call of Duty series.
